description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class 'MyAttendanceRecordAPITest' for testing the API endpoints of the 'MyAttendanceRecordAPI' class in the OrangeHRM attendance plugin. It includes tests for retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting attendance records, as well as setup pre-hooks for workflow states.

classes.name: MyAttendanceRecordAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the API endpoints of the MyAttendanceRecordAPI, including tests for fetching, creating, updating, and deleting attendance records and setting workflow pre-hooks.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Tests retrieving all attendance records using the API.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestGetAll
methods.description: Provides test cases for the 'testGetAll' method.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Tests retrieving a single attendance record, expects a 'not implemented' exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Tests validation rules for 'getOne', expects a 'not implemented' exception.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Tests creating a new attendance record via the API.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestCreate
methods.description: Provides test cases for the 'testCreate' method.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Tests deleting an attendance record via the API.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestDelete
methods.description: Provides test cases for the 'testDelete' method.

methods.name: testUpdate
methods.description: Tests updating an attendance record via the API.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestUpdate
methods.description: Provides test cases for the 'testUpdate' method.

methods.name: enableUserCanModifyAttendancePreHook
methods.description: Configures workflow state machines to enable users to modify attendance records.

methods.name: enableUserCanChangeCurrentTimePreHook
methods.description: Sets up workflow states to allow users to change their current punch time.
